name: Aqua Byte
rules: Each team shall consist of 2 participants
The questions will cover General Knowledge, Technical Knowledge, Programming,Information Technology, Computer Science, and other IT-related topics
The use of mobile phones, smartwatches, or any electronic gadgets is strictly prohibited during the event
The decision of the judges shall be final and binding
Any malpractice or violation of the quiz rules will lead to disqualification

name: Abyss Arena
rules: A team must consist of 4 players
Use of emulators, iPads and triggers is not allowed
Players must bring their own mobile devices, chargers, finger sleeves and earphones
Players should ensure their devices are compatible with the game and that they have the latest version installed
All required maps must be downloaded before the event
Players must have their own internet connection available as a backup
Any misconduct or unfair play will result in disqualification
Organizers' decisions will be final and binding

name: AquaVerse
description: Only the boldest minds can conquer the future
rules: The topic for each round will be disclosed a few minutes before the round begins
Judges decisions are final and binding. No objections or disputes will be entertained
Participants must always maintain a respectful and professional demeanour
Use of offensive language, inappropriate content, cheating, or disrespectful behaviour will result in immediate disqualification

name: Ocean Enigma
rules: Each team shall consists of 2 participants
Mystery will be revealed only at the event
Surprise bonus challenges may appear anytime
Use your brain, not gadgets, electronic devices are not allowed.
Some tasks will be time-based
Judges' decisions are final and binding.
Maintain fair play and sportsmanship throughout the event

name: Leviathan
description: Only one can rule the depths
rules: This is a solo event, and each participant will compete individually
The competition will consist of 4 rounds
Participants are expected to maintain professional and respectful conduct throughout the event
Participants must follow the instructions given by the organizers during each round
Any form of cheating, unfair practice, or misconduct will result in disqualification
The decision of the judges and organizers will be final

name: The Meg Pitch
rules: Round 1 (Tech Battle Royale), teams pick one technology – AI, Cyber Security, IoT, or Blockchain – and prepare exactly 5 slides pitching a startup idea, incorporating any challenge cards given during the round.
Round 2 (One-Slide Mastery), qualifying teams prepare a single slide that builds on their Round 1 idea, including logo, brief explanation, business model, and funding needs
Each round has a strict presentation time of 5 minutes (4 minutes presenting + 1 minute for questions)
The decision of the judges shall be final and binding
